name: part-of-speech
description:
The part of speech of each word of a phrase, by space: «купить диван» → «v n».

The codes are those of the bundled dictionary: n (noun), v (verb), a (adjective), p (participle), advb (adverb), prn (pronoun), prep (preposition), conj (conjunction), prt (particle), nv (as in the dictionary), and unkn for a word no rule gives a part of speech («кляк», «15»), so no code is empty.

The step writes its result to a new column <column>_pos.

Example: semkit read core.csv part-of-speech write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
